frame: rtp_local frame, metres, glTF Y up: three (x, y, z) = (x east, height above this floor's finished floor level, -north). Already north up and placed: no turn, no shift. Put the model at y = 15.0 m (finished floor level above ground).
decoder: GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder); repeated furniture comes as EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing (InstancedMesh); extras.instance_names lists the CAD blocks in instance order

camera.note: near >= 0.1 m keeps depth precision for the floor-level layers (finishes 3-4 mm apart)

lightmapped_meshes.how: texture = load(lightmap); texture.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace; texture.flipY = false; texture.channel = 1; material.lightMap = texture; material.lightMapIntensity = lightMapIntensity (below, per node); material.envMapIntensity = 0; no direct lights on these meshes (the lightmap already holds sun, sky, lamps and bounce). If it looks blown, check lightMap.colorSpace is sRGB and that the environment / lights are not also lighting these meshes.

other_meshes.environment: RoomEnvironment through PMREMGenerator, scene.environmentIntensity = 0.6, no punctual lights; emissive materials as exported

glass.facade_glass: replace with the viewer's tuned transparent glass
